Houses on the sunlit side of two islands.

Solell is a small agency for people buying a home in Ibiza or Mallorca. We keep a short list, six houses at present, and we know each one room by room.

Enquire privately See the six homes

A short list, kept on purpose.

Solell is the Catalan word for the side of a hill that takes the sun. It is where the islands’ farmhouses were built, long before anyone thought of a view.

We work the same way. Other agencies will show you two thousand properties and a search box. We would sooner show you six houses we have walked at seven in the morning and again at dusk, and tell you plainly which one we would buy.

Six houses, chosen slowly.

Three in Ibiza, three in Mallorca. The list changes when a house sells, not before. Guide prices are in euros.

Looking for something that is not here? Most of what we sell is never advertised. Tell us what you have in mind.

Solell is a concept. The homes and prices are illustrative, and the photographs are stand-ins showing public places on the islands, not the homes described.

Two islands, and they are not alike.

Ibiza

A cove near Sant Josep

Small enough to cross in forty minutes, and quieter than its reputation once you leave the coast road. The north is pine, red earth and white farmhouses; the south-west has the coves and the long sunsets.

  • Sant Carles
  • Santa Gertrudis
  • Sant Josep
  • Dalt Vila

Mallorca

Deià, from the south

Seven times the size, with a mountain range down its west coast and a proper city at its foot. Stone villages in the Tramuntana, vineyards on the plain, and a south-east of honey-coloured towns and narrow inlets.

  • Deià
  • Valldemossa
  • Fornalutx
  • Santanyí

Four steps, none of them hurried.

  1. 1

    A conversation

    You tell us how you want to live here: which months, who comes with you, what you never want to hear from the terrace.

  2. 2

    A short list

    We answer with three or four houses, some of them never advertised. For each one we say what is wrong with it as well as what is right.

  3. 3

    Viewings, unhurried

    We arrange them around your travel and meet you at the door. Come back at dusk if you like. Most people should.

  4. 4

    Through to the keys

    We introduce an independent lawyer, a surveyor and a tax adviser, and we stay with the purchase until it completes at the notary.
